expected: First-second rate samples are zero; paced sustained download exposes nonzero bytes-per-second.

mappings.rationale: Paced 1 MiB payload produces samples during first second that must have zero rate and subsequent nonzero rate samples, with successful exact B deployment.

Paced 1 MiB required payload generates repeated changed signals; C checks readable status and boolean estimating, bounded percentage and stable monotonic start time during positive transfer, monotonic bytes; Python requires payload-sized byte count and successful B deployment.
